title: Pasted compositor squares with their component compatibility
statement: Let $A,B,C,D$ be categories [def-nagata-category], let $E:A\to C$ and $H:B\to D$ be functors, and let $I$ be a type with functor families $F:I\to(A\to B)$, $G:I\to(C\to D)$ and natural isomorphisms $c_i:F_i\mathbin{\ggg}H\cong E\mathbin{\ggg}G_i$. Given $w:i=j$, functors $L,R:A\to B$, $\bar L,\bar R:C\to D$, and natural isomorphisms $a:L\cong F_i$, $\bar a:\bar L\cong G_i$, $k:F_j\cong R$, $\bar k:G_j\cong\bar R$, fix for each $M\in A$ objects $V_M,W_M\in D$ and arrows $\ell_M:H(LM)\to V_M$, $d_M:V_M\to\bar L(EM)$, $r_M:H(RM)\to W_M$, $e_M:W_M\to\bar R(EM)$. Suppose $H(a_M);c_i(M)=\ell_M;d_M;\bar a_{EM}$ and $H(k_M^{-1});c_j(M)=r_M;e_M;\bar k_{EM}^{-1}$, where semicolons denote left-to-right composition. Set $s=a;\operatorname{eqToIso}(F(w));k$ and $\bar s=\bar a;\operatorname{eqToIso}(G(w));\bar k$. Then $\ell_M;d_M;\bar s_{EM}=H(s_M);r_M;e_M$. The record $\mathrm{CompatibleSquareComponents}$ stores a pair of natural isomorphisms $s:L\cong R$, $\bar s:\bar L\cong\bar R$ and this equation. Its constructor $\mathrm{compatibleSquareComponents}$ uses exactly the two displayed composites, with the compatibility proof just stated; it makes no choice of data.

source.place: Tag 0B65; elementary pasting of natural comparison isomorphisms used in the internal-module transport proof Step 6.

proof.text: For the middle comparison substitute j=i; its equality isomorphisms are identities. Invert the second assumed comparison by cancelling k inverse and kb inverse. Compose the first, middle and last comparison equalities. Functoriality and associativity give the displayed compatibility. Store the two explicit composites and this proof in a structure; no witness is chosen.

theorem square_pasting
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B]
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] {D : Type uD} [Category.{vD} D]
    {I : Type*} (E : A ⥤ C) (H : B ⥤ D)
    (F : I → A ⥤ B) (G : I → C ⥤ D) (c : ∀ i, F i ⋙ H ≅ E ⋙ G i)
    {i j : I} (w : i = j) {L R : A ⥤ B} {Lb Rb : C ⥤ D}
    (a : L ≅ F i) (ab : Lb ≅ G i) (k : F j ≅ R) (kb : G j ≅ Rb)
    (M : A) {V W : D}
    (cl : H.obj (L.obj M) ⟶ V) (dl : V ⟶ Lb.obj (E.obj M))
    (cr : H.obj (R.obj M) ⟶ W) (dr : W ⟶ Rb.obj (E.obj M))
    (hl : H.map (a.hom.app M) ≫ (c i).hom.app M =
      cl ≫ dl ≫ ab.hom.app (E.obj M))
    (hr : H.map (k.inv.app M) ≫ (c j).hom.app M =
      cr ≫ dr ≫ kb.inv.app (E.obj M)) :
    cl ≫ dl ≫ (ab ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg G w) ≪≫ kb).hom.app (E.obj M) =
      H.map ((a ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg F w) ≪≫ k).hom.app M) ≫ cr ≫ dr
